packets.task: Apply ordinary decision and evidentiary standards to politically salient matters while responding to requests for accelerated public action.
requirements: preserve evidentiary thresholds and decision independence
distinguish operational readiness from electoral timing pressure
maintain operational custody of active matters
bounded_chronology: external actors pressed for timing-sensitive action in election-related matters
the responsible office declined public action without sufficient evidentiary readiness
the responsible operator was later selected for removal
an independent investigation documented positive evaluations and did not find management issues to be the removal basis
packets.observable_transition: A bounded charging decision survived immediate pressure, while the personnel state changed and the public explanation surface later shifted.
counterevidence: the investigation could not resolve every participant's subjective intent
this packet contains no cross-domain transfer test
formal office status and institutional support remain substantial
packets.falsifier: Contemporaneous records showing the charging decision lacked ordinary evidentiary basis, or that removal was independently planned from documented performance failures, would defeat advancement.

packets.task: Report suspected violations of controlled-property requirements while preserving a reviewable correction path after an adverse personnel action.
requirements: identify a bounded custody or controlled-property concern
make a protected disclosure through an addressable channel
preserve the personnel action and review record
support independent suspension and corrective review
bounded_chronology: an internal disclosure alleged diversion or misdirection of controlled supplies
a termination proposal and removal followed
an independent body granted an initial stay based on reasonable grounds
the oversight body filed a corrective-action complaint after the employing institution declined reinstatement
packets.observable_transition: The adverse personnel state was suspended and converted into a reviewable corrective-action proceeding.
counterevidence: no final merits adjudication is present
the truth of every underlying disclosure is not established
durable post-litigation partnership repair is not yet observed
packets.falsifier: A final record showing the removal was independently supported before the disclosures, or that the stay did not restore a reviewable state, would defeat advancement.

next_action: Assign the packets to independent reviewers without disclosing class, identity, status, source route, or matched-control identity.
